column1: # SQL. Rule: the objects a file creates. Table, view, materialized view and
# CREATE TYPE are class; function, procedure and trigger are function; schema is
# package; index and sequence are variable (named database objects that are
# neither code nor a type). The name is the object's own name, without its schema
# (shop.orders is orders) and without quoting ("Line Items" is Line Items,
# `accounts` is accounts). Columns are NOT extracted: the database scanner in
# internal/analyze already records every table and column. ALTER, DROP, GRANT,
# INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and SELECT only use objects and are not definitions;
# an unnamed index (CREATE INDEX ON t (c)) has no name and is not extracted.
